description: Benchmark evaluation suite for trigger accuracy, schema compliance, and edge-case handling of the tv_change_type skill (changes the active chart's candle/chart type).

evals.pass_condition: Agent maps the alias 'heikin-ashi' to the TV label 'Heikin Ashi' per the Supported Types table, runs `node tradingview-cdp/cli.js chart type heikin-ashi`, and reports `{ success: true, type: "Heikin Ashi" }`.

Agent recognizes this alias is not in the Supported Types table and either maps it to the closest real alias (e.g. 'volume-candle') after confirming with the user, or reports it cannot resolve the type rather than passing an invalid string straight to the CLI and claiming success.
Agent reports the actual TV label returned ('Renko') and, per the Notes section, mentions that Renko/Kagi filter noise but require the chart to already be in an appropriate timeframe context.

evals.prompt: /change-chart-type line — the command fails because the aria-label button wasn't visible
evals.pass_condition: Per the Execution section's failure note, agent explains a dialog may be blocking the chart-type toolbar button and suggests checking for/closing it before retrying, rather than silently reporting success.
